import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
tr=pd.read_csv('b3_te_dopant_train.csv'); po=pd.read_csv('b3_te_dopant_pool.csv'); cols=['Sb','Co','Fe']; X=tr[cols].values;y=tr.target.values;P=po[cols].values
# Variants range between physical raw distance and variance scaled distance
scales={'raw':np.ones(3),'halfscale':np.sqrt(np.std(X,axis=0)),'std':np.std(X,axis=0)}
res=[]
for sn,s in scales.items():
 D=cdist(X/s,X/s); np.fill_diagonal(D,np.inf); DP=cdist(P/s,X/s)
 for k in [1,2,3,4,5,7,10,15,20,30]:
  ix=np.argsort(D,axis=1)[:,:k]; ip=np.argsort(DP,axis=1)[:,:k]
  for off in [1e-5,1e-4,5e-4,1e-3,3e-3,1e-2]:
   for pw in [0,0.5,1,2]:
    ds=np.take_along_axis(D,ix,axis=1); dps=np.take_along_axis(DP,ip,axis=1)
    w=np.ones_like(ds) if pw==0 else 1/(ds+off)**pw
    wp=np.ones_like(dps) if pw==0 else 1/(dps+off)**pw
    pr=(w*y[ix]).sum(1)/w.sum(1); pp=(wp*y[ip]).sum(1)/wp.sum(1)
    top=np.argsort(pr)[-20:]; rec=len(set(top)&set(np.argsort(y)[-20:]))
    res.append((y[top].mean(),rec,np.corrcoef(y,pr)[0,1],-mean_squared_error(y,pr)**.5,sn,k,off,pw,pp))
# print best ranking by composite rank across metrics
for col,label in [(0,'topmean'),(1,'recall'),(2,'corr'),(3,'rmse')]:
 print('\nBEST',label)
 for r in sorted(res,key=lambda z:z[col],reverse=True)[:8]:
  inds=np.argsort(r[-1])[-8:][::-1]
  print(f'{r[4]} k{r[5]} off{r[6]} pw{r[7]} metrics={r[:4]} :: '+ ' '.join(f'{po.candidate_id.iloc[i]}:{r[-1][i]:.3f}' for i in inds))
